units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10:9">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כמין ג׳</he> like a hill (the bullock between the two rams).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:6:1">Cant. R. to IV, 6</cite> <he>עשה ערלותיהן ג׳</he> he piled up their preputia; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 47:7">Gen. R. s. 47</cite> <he>העמידן גִבְעַת ערלות</he>; a. e.—Pl. <he>גְּבָעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Chagigah 15a:8">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>ברא הרים ברא ג׳</he> He created mountains, and (corresponding to them) hills.
<cite ref="Taanit 8b:5">Taan. 8ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 37:13">Job XXXVII, 13</cite>) <he>אם לשבט בהרים וג׳</he> if He sends rain as a scourge, He sends it on mountains and hills.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17a:13">Ab. Zar. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>הרים וג׳</he> ye mountains and hills! <cite ref="Sotah 5a">Sot. 5ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Gittin 6b:12">Gitt. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>עסיק בפלגש ג׳</he> studying the case of the woman murdered in Gibeah (<cite ref="Judges 19">Jud. XIX</cite> sq.).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>בפלגש בג׳</he> in the war about the woman of G.; a. e.—
Shebu. 35ᵇ שמות האמורין בג׳ Rashi (ed. בגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִין) the names (Adonai, El &c.) used in the chapter about Gibeah (Jud. XX).
